hidden_test_cmd: sh -c 'PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" exec python -m pytest -q -p no:subtests "$@"' sh tests/hidden
tests_may_change_note: The real fix renamed and widened test_optimize_uncorrelated_in_nulls; a fix may add cases to any of the optimizer's test_optimize*/test_unnest* methods. Fixture files are not test code.

replay.reference_note: the fix's whole diff, tests and fixtures included
replay.hidden_tests_from: the fix's TestOptimizer::test_optimize_in_nulls, correlated cases only, on its own DuckDB tables with NULLs, plus the issue's own query; the fix's exact fixture outputs are not used, so another NULL-safe rewrite also passes

naive_patches.naive.patch: skips the rewrite only when the IN is negated or compared (=, <>, IS); the select list, COALESCE and AND/OR inside NOT still change results
naive_patches.naive-where-only.patch: never unnests unless the IN sits directly in WHERE: results are right, but WHERE ... IN ... AND ... is no longer unnested, which the ticket keeps
